name: Parents Responsibilities
overview: Scripture teaches that children are a divine heritage and a reward from the Lord, emphasizing the sacred trust parents have in their upbringing. Parents are called to diligently train and discipline their children, using correction and reproof as tools to guide them away from foolishness and toward wisdom. Loving discipline, including the use of the rod, is portrayed not as harshness but as an expression of care that shapes a child's character and ensures lasting faithfulness. Neglecting this responsibility leads to shame and folly, underscoring the importance of active, God-centered parenting.
